about: I just helped sell this home, and I’d be glad to tell you what your home could bring in today’s market.
I can pull the recent sales near you and walk you through them, so you know where you stand.
There is no cost for that first conversation, and you do not have to list.
sold.label: Thinking of selling?
back: Here’s how I’d start: we walk through your home together and talk about your plans and your timing.
I pull the recent sales on your street and the streets around it, so the numbers come from real houses.
You get a written estimate of what your home is worth, at no cost.
I point out what is worth fixing before you list and what you can leave alone.
Then we talk through a timeline that fits when you want to move.
If a question comes up along the way, call or text me and I will answer it myself.
Not ready yet? Keep my number for when you are.
